summary: LOBO TECHNOLOGIES LTD., a British Virgin Islands foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-09-18 providing unaudited interim consolidated financial statements as of and for the six months ended 2026-06-30, plus an operating and financial review exhibit. The filing is a routine half-year reporting obligation under the 1934 Act, not a special-situation event: no stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated. The only signature is CEO Huajian Xu. No deal terms exist. What to watch: nothing arbitrageable; monitor ordinary earnings trends and any future corporate action, since none is disclosed here.
